{{missingInfo|1|enva}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Bug |type2=Steel |trainername=Goh |pokemonname=Scizor |jtrainername=ゴウ |jpokemonname=ハッサム |tmtrainername=Go |tmpokemonname=Hassam |image=[[File:Goh Scizor.png|250px]] |caption=Goh's Scizor |prevonum=123 |evo1num=212 |evolution=1 |firstevoep=JN056 |firstevoname=Searching for Chivalry! |firststagename=Scyther |numeps1=50| |epnum=JN006 |epname=Working My Way Back to Mew! |location=[[Vermilion Forest]] |current=[[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] |gender=Unknown |ability=Unknown |java1=[[Shin-ichiro Miki]] |enva1=[[Sam Black]] |java2=[[Shin-ichiro Miki]] |enva2=Unknown }} '''Goh's Scizor''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのハッサム''' ''Go's Hassam'') is the twelfth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and his thirteenth overall. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== {{p|Scizor}} debuted as a {{p|Scyther}} in ''[[JN006|Working My Way Back to Mew!]]'', where it was the last {{type|Bug}} Pokémon native to the [[Kanto]] [[region]] that [[Goh]] needed to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}}. It easily repelled Goh's {{i|Poké Ball}} and sent him and {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}} flying. Later, Goh briefly battled the [[Pokémon category|Mantis Pokémon]] with his Scorbunny before finally catching it. Afterwards, it was seen with all of his other Pokémon before [[Professor Cerise]] suggested leaving it at his [[Cerise Laboratory|Laboratory]]. In ''[[JN007|Serving Up the Flute Cup!]]'', Goh used Scyther in his first [[Pokémon battle]] during the [[Battle Frontier Flute Cup]]. It battled [[Hodge]]'s {{p|Mightyena}}, where it used {{m|Swords Dance}} before quickly falling to Mightyena's {{m|Fire Fang}}. In ''[[JN015|A Snow Day for Searching!]]'', Goh used Scyther alongside some of his other Bug Pokémon to find the bone of a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{TP|Goh|Cubone}}, which he later caught. During a food shortage in ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', Scyther led a group of Goh's Bug-type Pokémon during a rebellion. They targeted {{TP|Goh|Darmanitan}}, {{TP|Goh|Grimer}}, {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Ekans}}, and {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Stantler}}. When {{TP|Goh|Golurk}} lost control, Scyther protected Goh's three {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Dustox|Cascoon}}. [[File:Castle of Chivalry Knight Medals.png|thumb|250px|Scyther and Goh getting their Knight Medals]] In ''[[JN056|Searching for Chivalry!]]'', Scyther volunteered for a training challenge hosted by [[Kalos]] [[Elite Four]] member [[Wikstrom]] at the [[Castle of Chivalry]], alongside {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Farfetch'd}}. In the first phase, the group was stopped by a {{p|Probopass}} belonging to the Elite Trainer; with great difficulty, the group managed to get through the round. In the second phase, Goh and Scyther enter a maze where they were separated from the rest of the group. This time, the two had to collaborate while being attacked by Pokémon on the way. [[File:Metal Coat anime.png|thumb|left|250px|Scyther holding the Metal Coat]] In the final part of the challenge, Scyther battled against Wikstrom's {{p|Aegislash}} until Ash and Goh decided to let Ash and Farfetch'd battle it. At the same time, Goh and Scyther attempted to catch Wikstrom's {{p|Klefki}}, which was carrying a key required to pass the challenge. They eventually succeeded, earning the participating Trainers and Pokémon one medal each. Afterward, Wikstrom offered to help Goh [[Evolution|evolve]] his Scyther. Goh agreed to this, and Wikstrom gave Scyther a [[Metal Coat]] to hold before it was transferred through a [[trade machine]], causing the Mantis Pokémon to evolve into Scizor. In ''[[JN060|Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to be a Leek Master!]]'', Goh used Scizor in a {{pkmn|training}} battle against Ash's {{p|Farfetch'd}}, during which it was shown to have learned {{m|X-Scissor}}. The battle ended without a proper victor as both Pokémon began tiring out and were subsequently taken to be healed at a [[Pokémon Center]]. In ''[[JN071|Leaping Toward the Dream!]]'', Goh used Scizor to find an {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Ninetales}} as a part of his [[Project Mew]] qualification mission. Scizor alerted Ash and Goh when it found Ninetales and was subsequently used to battle the [[Pokémon category|Fox Pokémon]]. Despite having a type advantage, Scizor quickly ended up getting {{status|frozen}} by an {{m|Ice Beam}}, forcing Goh to recall it. In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Scizor joined the rest of Goh's Pokémon at the lab to celebrate their Trainer's return from the last mission of [[Project Mew]]. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', it attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Goh and Scizor.png|thumb|left|250px|Scizor and Goh]] [[File:Goh Scyther and Bug Pokemon.png|thumb|250px|Scyther leading the Bug-type Pokémon in ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'']] Scizor is a fast and powerful {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}; thus, Goh had the most trouble catching it out of all the other [[Kanto]]-native {{t|Bug}} types he went after. It is enthusiastic about battling and staying active. In ''[[JN007|Serving Up the Flute Cup!]]'', it followed [[Mimey]]'s kung-fu exercises and was later seen shadowboxing to get Goh's attention to bring it to the [[Battle Frontier Flute Cup]]; in ''[[JN056|Searching for Chivalry!]]'', it rushed to Goh wanting to participate in the training challenge hosted by [[Wikstrom]]. Scizor is also shown to have a quick temper, as seen in ''[[JN015|A Snow Day for Searching!]]'' when Scyther began chasing a group of {{p|Geodude}} that threw snowballs at it. These behaviors particularly contrast with [[Goh's Pinsir]], who tried to avoid being selected for the Flute Cup and gets along with Goh's smaller Pokémon like {{TP|Goh|Caterpie}}. However, despite its rough demeanor, Scyther enjoys hugs, as seen in ''[[JN011|Best Friend...Worst Nightmare!]]'', when it accepted one from [[Ash's Dragonite]]. After its capture, Scizor quickly became one of Goh's most used Pokémon, next to {{TP|Goh|Cinderace}}. Despite its strength and confidence, Goh and Scizor are not as in sync with each other compared to Cinderace, and Goh's cautious strategy in the first round of the Flute Cup led to Scyther's quick defeat. Scyther didn't appear upset by the loss, returning from the [[Pokémon Center]] for another battle. Like Scorbunny, it seemed more concerned with how hard Goh was taking his first defeat. From ''[[JN056|Searching for Chivalry!]]'' onwards, Goh and Scyther are more aligned with each other, managing to pass the goals proposed by Wikstrom as a true team. Scizor is protective of other Pokémon, as seen in ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'' when it shielded a group of Goh's Bug types from {{TP|Goh|Darmanitan}}'s attack. Scizor is also a natural leader, as demonstrated when it commanded Goh's other Bug types to attack Darmanitan and its allies. ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{bug color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{bug color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{flying color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Scyther|000}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Goh Scyther.png|250px]] |} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|bug|steel|Goh {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Scyther Air Slash|1=Scyther Slash|2=Scyther Swords Dance|3=Scizor X-Scissor|4=Scizor Metal Claw}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Air Slash

As the events of its Evolution were omitted in {{ma|Pokémon Journeys|the manga}}, Scyther appeares already evolved as a Scizor facing [[Ash's Farfetch'd]] in ''[[JNM18|Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to Be a Leek Master!]]''. ====Appearance==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{bug color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{bug color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{flying color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Scyther|000}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Goh Scyther JNM.png|x170px]] |} ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|bug|steel|Goh Scyther Sword Dance JNM.png|Using Swords Dance as a Scyther}} {{anmov|normal|Swords Dance|JNM03|Battle Frontier Challenge: The Flute Cup!}} {{anmov/f|steel}} {{-}} ==In the games== ====[[Pokémon Ga-Olé]]==== Scyther appears in [[Pokémon Ga-Olé]] as one of Goh's Pokémon. It is an opponent during the {{OBP|Grand Rush set 4|Ga-Olé}}. =====As an opponent===== {| align="left" style="margin:auto; {{roundy|10px}}; background:#{{white color dark}}" |- | {| style="margin:auto; {{roundy|7px}}; background:#{{white color light}}" |- | style="vertical-align:top" | {{Ga-OlePokémon|type=Bug|type2=Flying|name=Scyther|img=123Scyther|move=Fury Cutter|movetype=Bug}} |} |} {{-}} ====[[Pokémon GO]]==== On November 6, 2020, as part of Pokémon GO's [https://pokemongo.nianticlabs.com/post/animationweek2020/?hl=en Animation Week 2020] event, which was based on {{aniseries|JN}}, several Pokémon based on those that {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] encountered in the animated series appeared more frequently in the wild, in {{GO|Raid Battle|raid}}s, from 7 km [[List of Eggs in Pokémon GO|Eggs]], and during [[Photography#Pokémon GO|surprise encounters]], with Scyther appearing in the wild and in surprise encounters. The event ran from November 6, 2020, at 8:00 a.m., to November 12, 2020, at 10:00 p.m. local time. ====[[Pokémon Mezastar]]==== Scizor appears in [[Pokémon Mezastar]] as one of Goh's Pokémon. It appears as an opponent during the {{mezastar|Super Tag set 1|first Super Tag set}}. Upon beating Goh, the player can receive a Support Pokémon Ticket based on [[Goh's Cinderace]], with Scizor as its tag partner. =====As an opponent===== {| align="left" style="margin:auto; {{roundy|10px}}; background:#{{white color dark}}" |- | {| style="margin:auto; {{roundy|7px}}; background:#{{white color light}}" |- | style="vertical-align:top" | {{MezastarPokémon|type=Bug|type2=Steel|name=Scizor|img=212Scizor|move=X-Scissor|movetype=Bug}} |} |} {{-}} =====Disks===== {{MezastarExpansionList/header|Fire}} {{MezastarExpansionList/entry|2-1-012|{{OBP|Cinderace|2-1-012}}|Fire||5}} {{MezastarExpansionList/footer|Fire}} ==Trivia== * Scizor is Goh's first {{type|Steel}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. * Scizor is the only one of Goh's Pokémon to have one of its [[type]]s changed upon Evolution. * Scizor is the first Pokémon in the {{pkmn|animated series}} shown to have evolved while in its [[Poké Ball]]. * Not including Goh's [[first partner Pokémon]], Scizor, along with {{TP|Goh|Butterfree}}, holds the record for the most appearances out of Goh's Pokémon, at 26 main series episodes. * Out of all the Pokémon that were obtained and evolved during the course of ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'', Scyther took the longest to evolve, at 50 episodes. * Scizor is referred to as male in the {{pmin|Brazil|Brazil}}ian [[dub]]. ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo1|Scyther|Scizor}} {{Goh's Pokémon|bug|steel}} {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Goh's Pokémon|Scizor]] [[Category:Pokémon GO characters]] [[es:Scizor de Goh]] [[fr:Insécateur de Goh]] [[it:Scizor di Goh]] [[ja:ゴウのストライク]] [[zh:小豪的飞天螳螂]]
